$comment: Evidence map for Phase 38. Phase 38 composes Phase 32 evolution and currently has no dedicated executable acceptance suite; all criteria remain declared.

areas.area: Evolution engine ownership composes existing evolution capability
areas.requirement: Phase 38 stages managed transformation without creating a competing evolution-lifecycle capability or governance authority.

areas.area: Staged migrations and post-change invariant verification are defined
areas.requirement: Evolution programs provide staged migration, rollback, invariant verification and controlled retirement.

areas.area: Live platform evolution execution is wired
areas.requirement: Evolution programs execute at an authorized live boundary with durable state, evidence, rollback and conformance.
